evaluator_brief: Evaluate whether a student’s Final Year Project Report complies with the official TU CSIT Final Report Template and Formatting Standards.

output_record_format.evidence: Short quote/observation with page number(s) or 'not found'
output_record_format.fix: Concise, actionable correction when Non-compliant or Uncertain

source_preference.docx: Prefer style metadata (fonts, sizes, bold, alignment).

page_numbering_rules: Cover page: no page number displayed
Numbering starts from Supervisor’s Recommendation page
First visible page number must be lowercase Roman numeral ii
Preliminary pages use lowercase Roman numerals (ii, iii, iv, …)
Preliminary pages include: Supervisor’s Recommendation, Student’s Declaration, Letter of Approval, Acknowledgement, Abstract, TOC, List of Figures, List of Tables, List of Abbreviations
Arabic numerals (1, 2, 3, …) continue sequentially until the end, including References and Appendices
All page numbers must be centered at the bottom, one inch from the edge
No pages left unnumbered except the cover page
No duplication or gaps in numbering sequence
Restart of numbering is only allowed when switching from Roman to Arabic at Chapter 1

requirements.requirement: TU logo present at the top of the page.
Project title text is ALL CAPS.
Project title is BOLD.
Project title font size is 16pt.
Project title is CENTERED horizontally.
Line “A FINAL PROJECT REPORT” is present and centered under the title.
“Submitted to” line includes “Department of Computer Science and Information Technology”.
“Submitted to” block is centered.
“In partial fulfillment of the requirements for the Bachelor’s Degree in CSIT” is present and centered (or equivalent approved phrasing).
“Submitted by” block includes Student Name.
“Submitted by” block includes TU Roll No.
“Submitted by” block includes Date.
“Under the supervision of” line includes Supervisor Name.
Supervisor’s designation and institute are included (e.g., DWIT / IOST).
All elements on the title page are centered (including “Submitted to/by” and supervisor lines).
No page number is displayed on the title page.
Page margins conform to Top 1", Bottom 1", Left 1.25", Right 1".
Body font used is Times New Roman (or acceptable equivalent); no script/ornamental fonts.
No extraneous graphics other than TU logo; no watermarks.
Page heading “SUPERVISOR’S RECOMMENDATION” is present, bold, centered.
Formal recommendation paragraph is present.
Student’s name appears in ALL CAPS (not bold) within the text.
Project title appears in ALL CAPS and BOLD within the text.
Supervisor’s name is present under the text.
Supervisor’s designation is present.
College/Institute (DWIT/IOST) correctly stated.
Signature line/space included.
Page numbered with Roman numerals (e.g., i), centered at bottom.
Margins, font family, font size, and spacing conform to standards.
Heading “STUDENT’S DECLARATION” bold, centered.
Declaration states originality and exclusive authorship.
Student name provided below declaration.
Date provided below declaration.
Signature line/space present.
Page in Roman numbering; centered at bottom.
Margins, font, size, spacing conform.
Heading “LETTER OF APPROVAL” bold, centered.
Certifying statement text present.
Supervisor’s block includes name and designation.
Campus Chief’s block includes correct name and designation.
External Examiner block with designation/affiliation present.
Project Coordinator block with designation present.
Signature lines/spaces included for all signatories.
Roman page numbering; centered bottom.
Margins, font, size, spacing conform.
Heading “ACKNOWLEDGEMENT” bold, centered.
Formal academic tone; thanks to contributors (e.g., supervisor, institute).
Student name at end.
Roll no. at end.
Date at end.
Roman page numbering; centered bottom.
Margins, font, size, spacing conform.
Heading “ABSTRACT” bold, centered.
Includes Motivation/Problem statement.
Includes Methods/Approach.
Includes Results/Findings/Product.
Includes Conclusion/Implications.
Keywords present, 4–8 terms, separated by semicolons.
Roman page numbering; centered bottom.
Margins, font, size, spacing conform.
Heading “TABLE OF CONTENTS” bold, centered.
TOC is auto-generated using Word (not manual typing).
Shows correct hierarchical indentation for chapters, sections, subsections.
Dot leaders between headings and page numbers.
Page numbers in TOC match actual page numbers in document.
Roman page numbering; centered bottom.
Margins, font, size, spacing conform.
Heading “LIST OF FIGURES” bold, centered.
Automatically generated via Word Captions → Table of Figures.
Entries contain sequential figure numbers (Figure 1.1, 1.2, …) with captions.
Page numbers align with actual figure pages.
Roman page numbering; centered bottom.
Heading “LIST OF TABLES” bold, centered.
Automatically generated via Word Captions → Table of Figures (tables).
Entries contain sequential table numbers (Table 2.1, 2.2, …) with captions.
Page numbers align with actual table pages.
Roman page numbering; centered bottom.
Heading “LIST OF ABBREVIATIONS” bold, centered.
Entries are alphabetically ordered.
Each abbreviation has a clear expansion (e.g., HTML — Hypertext Markup Language).
Roman page numbering; centered bottom.
Heading “CHAPTER 1: INTRODUCTION” uses prescribed heading style.
1.1 Introduction present; gives overview and links to conclusion.
1.2 Problem Statement present; states problem, method claim, purpose/objective.
1.3 Objectives present; begins with “To …” and specific, aligned to problem.
1.4 Scope and Limitation present; clearly narrows study.
1.5 Development Methodology present; identifies chosen methodology.
1.6 Report Organization present; outlines chapter flow.
Heading style correct.
2.1 Background Study present; covers theories, concepts, terms, relevant only.
2.2 Literature Review present; synthesizes, compares, critiques (not mere summaries).
2.3 Current System present; comparable systems described.
2.4 Problems with Current System present; justified with sources or rationale.
Heading style correct.
3.1 Requirement Analysis present; process of elicitation and analysis described.
3.1.1 Functional Requirements present; “shall” phrasing; use-case diagram/desc included.
3.1.2 Non-Functional Requirements present; “must” phrasing; performance/usability/security etc.
3.2 Feasibility Analysis present; covers Technical, Operational, Economic, Schedule.
3.3 Analysis Diagrams present per approach:
— Structured: ER diagrams and DFDs present, labeled, readable.
— Object-Oriented: Class/Object, State/Sequence, Activity diagrams present, labeled, readable.
4.1 Design present; approach (Structured/OO) consistent with analysis.
Structured: Database design (ER to relations), normalization steps shown.
Structured: Forms/Report design described.
Structured: Interface/Dialog design described.
OO: Refined Class, Object, State, Sequence, Activity diagrams present.
OO: Component and Deployment diagrams present where applicable.
4.2 Algorithm Details present; core algorithms clearly specified.
5.1 Implementation present; critical code areas discussed without dumping large code.
5.1.1 Tools Used present; CASE tools, languages, DB platforms listed.
5.1.2 Implementation Details of Modules present; classes/functions/methods described.
5.2 Testing present; approach and coverage explained.
5.2.1 Unit Testing test cases tabulated.
5.2.2 System Testing test cases tabulated.
5.3 Result Analysis present; tests summarized; strengths/weaknesses discussed; comparisons if appropriate.
6.1 Conclusion present; restates thesis, synthesizes key points, final impression.
6.2 Future Recommendation present; limitations acknowledged; realistic improvements.
Heading “REFERENCES” bold, centered.
In-text citations use numbered brackets [n].
Reference list ordered by citation appearance (sequential), not alphabetic.
Each reference is complete and correctly formatted in IEEE style for its type.
All cited items appear in list; no missing entries.
No uncited entries in reference list unless in an optional Bibliography section.
Heading “APPENDIX” (or “APPENDIX A/B/…”) bold, centered.
Contains supplementary material (screenshots, logs, code, etc.) only.
Each appendix labeled and referenced where appropriate.
Paper size A4 across document.
Margins: Top 1", Bottom 1", Left 1.25", Right 1" across document.
Body font Times New Roman 12pt across document.
Line spacing 1.5 across body text.
Paragraphs justified with first-line indent 0.5".
Chapter/Section/Subsection heading sizes and boldness correct and consistent.
Page numbering: Roman for front matter; Arabic from Chapter 1; centered at bottom.
Figures centered; captions bold 12pt below figure; not split across pages.
Tables centered; captions bold 12pt above table; not split across pages.
Figure/Table numbering sequential by chapter (Figure X.Y, Table X.Y).
TOC/LoF/LoT are auto-generated (not manually typed).
List of Abbreviations alphabetically ordered.
No inconsistent fonts, sizes, or spacing anomalies.
No watermarks or distracting backgrounds.
No plagiarism indicators; all borrowed content cited.
